answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. By the garden of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The pigment lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the horizon is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
